body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: c859c79eb3bf735c4bfecd5dfea5de3e2d0d19d3 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.** No blockers.

The parents #4073 and #4207 are merged. The trial merge with `upstream/main` (b2afd64ed) is clean. The effective diff is the commit c859c79eb only: 14 files, all in `crates/ui`, `assets/themes`, `docs/decisions` and `docs/user-guide`.

## What looks good

- `close_hover` and `close_ink` are in `Tokens`, in the two built-in columns, in the overlay and in the colour vocabulary. Both columns keep the old values (`#C42B1C` and white). Thus no pixel changes.
- `window_chrome::caption` reads the two tokens. `CLOSE_HOVER` is removed, and no reference to it stays in `crates/`.
- The tests of `error_text.rs` move to `error_text_tests.rs` with no change. The guard row for `error_text.rs` is gone with them.
- The colour-literal guard now has only `keep:` rows. The count of `theme/tables.rs` (122) is correct.
- `COLOR_NAMES` has 61 entries, as the body says. The new test holds it inside `MAX_MAP_ENTRIES` (64).
- The example theme, the user guide table and `docs/decisions/1120-chrome-inks.md` have the two keys.
- The new test file is a module of the `theme_files` suite. There is no new test binary (#3187).
- All touched files are below 400 lines (the largest is `theme.rs`, 388).
- The body has before/after screenshots on the `pr-screenshots` branch. It also has the `Changelog:` line and `Fixes #1120`. No process file changes.

## Results (locally, trial merge with upstream/main b2afd64ed)

This is not a safety-tier review. The diff does not change posted G-code, gouge or collision checks, stock simulation or geometry.

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | 10 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled (14.8 min, cold build) |
| ui suites: lib | ok |
| ui suites: boundary, boundary_picks, contour_dxf_sketch, sinker_setup, tap_hand, theme_example, theme_files, waterjet_tool | ok |
| `cargo clippy --no-deps --all-targets -p camcraft-ui -- -D warnings` | clean |
| `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main --dry-run` | 0 steps reached; the diff reaches no heavy lane |

Extra suites run: none are owed. The diff changes no `testdata/` file, no fixture and no import code.

## Mutations (by the reviewer, then reverted)

1. `theme/tables.rs`: `close_ink` of the dark column set to `Color32::BLACK`. Result: `chrome_inks::the_built_in_columns_keep_the_close_button_colours` is red.
2. `window_chrome.rs`: the close ink set back to the literal `egui::Color32::WHITE`. Result: `colour_literals::no_colour_literal_outside_the_allowed_rows` is red ("1 colour literal(s), and the file has no row").

Both tests are green again on the restored tree.

## Requested before merge

None.

## Notes (not blocking)

- The body says that #4209 tracks the remaining `[f32; 3]` viewport line colours. Thus `Fixes #1120` is correct for the scope of #1120.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
